1.title: What is PostGen Web?
1.content: PostGen Web is a powerful LinkedIn content generation platform that combines artificial intelligence with professional writing expertise. Our dual-interface system provides both a local development environment (Studio) and a web-based interface for seamless content creation.

2.title: Key Features
2.content: 🤖 AI-Powered Content Generation . Leverage multiple AI models including Ollama's Llama 3, GPT-4o, Gemini, and Puter AI to create engaging LinkedIn posts tailored to your professional voice. 🔗 LinkedIn Integration . Seamlessly fetch and analyze your existing LinkedIn content to maintain consistency in tone and style across all your posts. 🎨 Professional Themes . Choose from Light, Dark, and Blue themes to customize your workspace according to your preferences. 📊 Content Management . Edit, copy, and export your generated content in multiple formats including Markdown for easy sharing and archiving.

3.title: How It Works
3.content: . | Connect: Link your LinkedIn credentials and API keys for enhanced functionality | Generate: Use our AI models to create professional content based on your prompts | Refine: Edit and customize the generated content to match your voice | Export: Download or copy your content for immediate use on LinkedIn | .

4.title: Technology Stack
4.content: . | Frontend: Jekyll with GitHub Pages for seamless deployment | Backend: FastAPI integration with PostGen Studio | AI Integration: Ollama, OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Puter AI | Deployment: GitHub Pages with local development support | .
